snippet.title: IMMORTUM - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist IMMORTUM today on Steam!

This psychological horror unravels your mind aboard the Immortum, a decaying spaceship carrying an impossible truth. Every wrong step risks a game over, and every right one twists your truth. Survive as Romi, a mother desperate to find her dying child in a foreign reality.
